pages.quiz:
ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #5
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 40
   D. 4

2. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 17
   C. 7
   D. 19

3. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 144
   C. 48
   D. 156

4. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 36
   C. 6
   D. 18

5. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 2/2
   C. Cannot tell
   D. 1/4

6. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 31
   D. 1

7. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.7
   B. 27
   C. 27.6
   D. 33

8. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 19.6
   C. 25
   D. 19

9. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 40

10. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 6x

11. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 120
   C. 46
   D. 23

12. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31
   C. 31.6
   D. 31.7

13. Solve for x: x + 7 = 19. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 13
   C. 7
   D. 12

14. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 43
   C. 1
   D. 1

15. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 26
   C. 13
   D. 169

16. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

17. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 25
   C. 26
   D. 10

18. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 90
   C. 18
   D. 36

19. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 23.7
   C. 29
   D. 23.6

20. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x < 5
   B. x > 5
   C. x = 5
   D. x ≥ 0 only

21. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 82
   C. 9
   D. 18

22. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 49
   D. 1

23. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 12
   C. 24
   D. 36

24. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 15.7
   C. 21
   D. 15.6

25. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 88
   B. 19
   C. 38
   D. 22

26. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 7
   C. 50
   D. 49

27. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 2
   C. 24
   D. 10

28. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 122
   C. 22
   D. 121

29. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 37

30. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 64
   B. 65
   C. 0
   D. 16
